overview: What you built in your old worlds turns up as weathered ruins in the new one.

0.1.0: Builds found in old worlds by the past-echos preprocessor stand as ruins on dry, level ground.
Worlds from 1.2.5 to 26.3 are read, their blocks and signs brought up to date.
Ruins weather: cracked and mossy stone, broken glass, burnt-out torches, missing blocks.
